test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 5: Participating in a Live Class
test_cases.test_case_title: Student logs in to participate in a video session
test_cases.pre_condition: The student 'student_newuser@example.com' has an active account with password 'NewStudent123!', is enrolled in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course, and the teacher has initiated the live video session. The current screen is '2.1.1.4 SC-006: Video Session Screen'.
test_cases.expected_result: The student 'student_newuser@example.com' is successfully authenticated, their session is initiated, and they are redirected to the Dashboard Page, where they can see their courses and join the live video session. The system displays the Dashboard Page with the course listing.
test_cases.post_condition: The student is logged in, and their session is active on the Dashboard Page, ready to join the video session.

test_steps.step: Navigate from '2.1.1.4 SC-006: Video Session Screen' to '2.1.1.1 SC-001: Landing Page'
